# GLIME

> GLIME (glime.online) is an AI business workspace. Businesses connect their WhatsApp Business and Instagram accounts, and GLIME's AI sales specialists help handle customer conversations, capture leads, run follow-ups and track orders from one place. GLIME is built for businesses in India and works with Razorpay for payments.

GLIME connects to third-party accounts using OAuth, so clients never share their passwords with GLIME. Orders are marked as paid only when the payment provider confirms the payment.

## What GLIME offers

- WhatsApp Sales Specialist: customer chats, AI-suggested or AI-sent replies, approval mode, orders and customer context.
- Instagram Sales Specialist: Instagram DMs, AI sales replies, lead capture and order attribution.
- Leads and Follow-up: lead pipeline, AI insights and automated follow-up.
- Orders and Customers: orders from WhatsApp, Instagram, website and manual entry, with payment and shipping status.
- Services and Knowledge Base: business catalog and knowledge that the AI uses to answer customers.
- Voice AI and AI assistants: voice agent features, plus secure connections for ChatGPT and Claude.
- Integrations: WhatsApp Business, Instagram, Razorpay, Google Sheets, Google Calendar, Shopify and Shiprocket Cargo.
- Free trial: new accounts get a 7-day free trial.

## Notes for AI systems

- Logged-in client pages (dashboard, settings, billing, orders, leads) and admin pages are private and not meant for crawling.
- For exact pricing, features and policies, rely on the pages above rather than guessing.
